title: Baicalin downregulates Thromboxane A(2) receptor via SIRT1/NRF2 and NLRP3 pathways to attenuate Cyclosporine A-induced hypertension.
authors: Gao, Teng; Li, Quanbin; Chen, Jialiang; Li, Qian; Fan, Xiaoxuan; Yang, Luping; Liu, Jiping; Wang, Bin; Wang, Chuan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究黄酮类化合物黄芩苷通过SIRT1/NRF2和NLRP3通路缓解环孢素A诱导的高血压，涉及蛋白-小分子结合与分子对接，但核心对象为蛋白-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Cyclosporine A, an immunosuppressant, is clinically limited by its hypertensive and nephrotoxic effects. Baicalin, a bioactive flavonoid derived from Scutellaria baicalensis, effectively alleviates CsA-induced hypertension by downregulating the thromboxane A(2) (TP) receptor via the SIRT1/NRF2 and NLRP3 pathways. Ex vivo, in vivo, and in vascular smooth muscle cells (VSMCs), baicalin markedly reversed CsA-induced vasoconstriction, elevated blood pressure, upregulation of TP receptor, KEAP-1, NLRP3, Caspase-1, IL-1beta, and ASC, as well as downregulation of SIRT1, NRF2, HO-1, and NQO-1. Importantly, siRNA-mediated knockdown of SIRT1 or NLRP3 abolished baicalin's protective effects. CETSA and ITDRF-CETSA demonstrated that baicalin directly binds to and stabilizes SIRT1 and NLRP3. Molecular docking further confirmed strong binding affinity of baicalin to both TP receptor and SIRT1. Immunofluorescence revealed that baicalin significantly inhibited CsA-induced NLRP3/ASC speck formation. Collectively, baicalin may improve CsA-induced hypertension by downregulating the TP receptor through the SIRT1/NRF2 and NLRP3 pathways.
abstract_zh: 环孢素A作为一种免疫抑制剂，其临床应用受限于其引起的高血压和肾毒性副作用。黄芩苷，一种源自黄芩的生物活性黄酮类化合物，通过SIRT1/NRF2和NLRP3通路下调血栓素A(2)（TP）受体，有效缓解CsA诱导的高血压。在离体、体内及血管平滑肌细胞（VSMCs）实验中，黄芩苷显著逆转了CsA诱导的血管收缩、血压升高、TP受体、KEAP-1、NLRP3、Caspase-1、IL-1β和ASC的上调，以及SIRT1、NRF2、HO-1和NQO-1的下调。重要的是，通过siRNA介导的SIRT1或NLRP3敲低消除了黄芩苷的保护作用。CETSA和ITDRF-CETSA实验表明，黄芩苷直接结合并稳定SIRT1和NLRP3。分子对接进一步证实了黄芩苷与TP受体和SIRT1的强结合亲和力。免疫荧光显示，黄芩苷显著抑制了CsA诱导的NLRP3/ASC斑点形成。综上所述，黄芩苷可能通过SIRT1/NRF2和NLRP3通路下调TP受体，从而改善CsA诱导的高血压。
